title: Патефон ПТ-3 — Soviet portable wind-up suitcase gramophone (primary: Молотовский патефонный завод, г. Молотов/Пермь)
era: USSR 1930s–1950s; ПТ-3 standard model 1935–1957 (licensed copy of HMV Model 102). Pre-war: Коломенский патефонный завод 1934–41; post-war: Молотовский 1945/46–1956 (~1M units by 1954, the most widespread in the USSR), Московский 1946–62, «Молот» Вятские Поляны, Владимирский, Ленинградский

case_dimensions.note: Model = ПТ-3 (factory manual figures; primary). Independent cross-checks, same model: muscol_pt3 410×285×165; pc1_pt3_moscow ≈410×290×165, 7,5 kg; artefact_pt3_molotov 412×290×175; artefact_pt3_altai 400×285×160, 7,2 kg; gagarin_museum 410×280×170; dvaveka_molotov (measured) 415×295×180; HMV 102 prototype 410×285×155 (muscol_hmv102). Spread: L 400–415, D 280–295, H(closed) 155–180. Smaller «Молот» Vyatskie-Polyany variant 360–370×230–290×155–160 (restoration_molot) — NOT the primary.

platter.construction: Stamped steel disc with polished rim, on centre spindle, fixed by figured split washer
platter.mat: Thin felt (сукно) glued on top — most often light green («светло-зелёные»), rarer bright crimson («ярко-малиновые»); HMV prototype used woollen cloth; one Vladimir-factory PT-3 example had a rubber mat (variant)
platter.src: construction+washer: muscol_pt3; mat colours verbatim: oldpatefon_felt; woollen cloth: muscol_hmv102; diameter DERIVED — see derivation, exact mm in needs[]

tonearm.finish: Nickel/chrome-plated, S-shaped tube of variable section with two joints (horizontal + vertical movement)
tonearm.soundbox: Round soundbox (мембрана): aluminium diaphragm on a bakelite base, covered by chrome-plated slotted cap; needle clamped by knurled screw; soundbox sits on a turning bend of the tonearm
tonearm.parked_position: Swung to the far right, behind the platter — manual: «Отведите тонарм за мембрану в крайнее правое положение»; rests over a support at the right/rear of the deck when closed
tonearm.src: S-shape/soundbox/cap: muscol_hmv102 + muscol_pt3; jointed tube: artefact_patefon_tisul; parking quote: starogitnosti_manual; photo_open confirms right-rear park. Soundbox diameter is a photo-derived estimate (needs[])

crank.position: Removable crank inserts into a hole in the RIGHT side wall of the case («справа футляра», into the winding worm gear); sits toward the front-bottom of the right wall in reference photos
crank.operation: 30–35 turns clockwise = full wind (one wind ≈ 1–2 record sides; 25 cm side ≈ 3 min)
crank.stowage: In transport the crank clips to the inner side of the lid («В походном положении рукоятку закрепляли на внутренней стороне крышки»)
crank.grip: Carbolite (bakelite) grip on folding steel arm
crank.src: hole side verbatim: starogitnosti_manual + artefact_pt3_molotov («отверстие с правой стороны устройства») + muscol_hmv102 («slot on the case right side»); turns: pt3_factory_manual; play time: wiki_patefon; stowage: artefact_pt3_molotov; grip: oldpatefon_molot; photo_crank shows inserted position. Length is a photo-derived estimate (needs[])

lid.hinge_position: Rear long edge (back wall) — pivot/piano hinges
lid.stay: Held open slightly past vertical by a locking bar / «рычаг крышкодержателя» (lid-stay lever)
lid.inner_lid_features: Cloth lining (blue-grey in photo_open) with factory rhombus decal/logo top-centre; wire record holder on inner face (some factories/years); clip for the stowed crank
lid.src: hinge+stay: muscol_pt3 («catch … pivot hinge») + muscol_hmv102 («fixed in open position by the locking bar») + starogitnosti_manual (крышкодержатель); lining+decal: photo_open + artefact_patefon_tisul (interior lid factory logo); wire holder: cozythings_molotov; crank clip: artefact_pt3_molotov. Open angle is photo-derived (needs[])

case_finish.carcass: Wood — pine carcass with birch plywood panels
case_finish.covering: Dermantine/lederin (ледерин) glued over the wood — black most common; documented variants: dark red-brown, red («красный ледерин»), green fabrikoid (HMV); «от дешевых дерматиновых до подарочных лаковых» (cheap dermantine up to gift lacquered cases)
case_finish.corners: Nickel-plated metal fittings («фурнитура — никелированный метал»); corner protectors visible on some examples in photos — variant hardware, confirm per factory (needs[])
case_finish.handle: Carrying handle on the FRONT long wall (latch side) in reference photos — leather/leatherette strap type on PT-3 (muscol EN text words it 'case lateral side')
case_finish.latch: Spring catch/latch on the front long wall, centre; lid hooks over the body rim
case_finish.src: carcass: restoration_molot; covering: starogitnosti_manual (дерматин) + dvaveka_molotov (ледерин) + artefact_pt3_molotov (variants quote) + restoration_molot (red) + oldpatefon_molot (red-brown) + muscol_hmv102 (green fabrikoid); fittings: pc1_pt3_moscow; handle+latch placement: photo_open + photo_crank + muscol_pt3 (catch)

horn_vents.horn: Internal exponential folded horn under the deck (motor board); «рупор является естественным продолжением тонарма» — tonearm feeds the horn at its rear-right base; horn body of tinplate, smooth or ribbed depending on factory
horn_vents.sound_exit: Sound exits UP through a decoratively shaped window cut in the REAR part of the deck panel («The sound is output from ornately shaped window in the panel rear part»; monetnik: «oval-shaped sound outlet») into the open-lid cavity — the patefon is played lid-open; no grille in the lid, no side louvres
horn_vents.deck_layout_around_it: Platter centre-left of deck; speed-regulator lever with dial «МЕДЛЕН/78/БЫСТРО» left of platter; brake lever right; autostop toggle «Включено/Выключено»; lubrication openings in the mounting board
horn_vents.src: exponential horn: pc1_pt3_moscow; tonearm-continuation: starogitnosti_manual + artefact_patefon_tisul; exit window verbatim: muscol_hmv102 (PT-3 prototype, same deck) + muscol_pt3 («hidden beneath the panel, sound output directed outward») + monetnik (oval outlet); tinplate smooth/ribbed: oldpatefon_variants; deck levers/dial: muscol_pt3 + pt3_factory_manual
horn_vents.needle_box: Small lidded needle box («ящичек для сменных игл») set into one deck corner — nickel-plated brass box on Moscow ММП variant; front-left corner in most reference photos (corner not pinned in text — needs[])

derivation.game_units: 1 unit = 1 m → closed case 0.414 × 0.288 × 0.160 (L×D×H), lid-open total height ≈ 0.16 + lid_h·sin(102°)
derivation.platter_diameter_mm: ≈240 = 250 mm standard «гранд» 78-rpm record (wiki_patefon: «25 см пластинка») × ~0.96 — record overhangs the polished platter rim slightly in photo_open/photo_crank; exact figure unsourced → needs[]
derivation.body_lid_split_mm: lid ≈ 55, body ≈ 105 of the 160 closed height — photo proportion ≈ 0.35 H (photo_open); unsourced → needs[]
derivation.soundbox_diameter_mm: ≈78 ≈ platter_diameter × 1/3 measured off photo_crank (soundbox vs record); unsourced → needs[]
derivation.crank_length_mm: ≈140 ≈ case length × 1/3 measured off photo_crank; unsourced → needs[]
derivation.lid_open_angle: ≈100–105° read off photo_open (lid leans slightly past vertical against the stay); stay confirmed textually, angle value unsourced → needs[]

feature_inventory.feature: Suitcase wooden case 414×288×160 mm, dermantine/lederin-covered (black primary; red/red-brown/lacquer variants)
Lid hinged at rear, spring latch front-centre, lid-stay bar holds it ~vertical when open
Carry handle (leather/leatherette strap) on front long wall beside the latch
Nickel-plated hardware: latch, hinges, fittings; corner protectors on some examples
Stamped-steel platter, polished rim, glued thin felt mat (light green most common, crimson rarer), figured split washer on spindle
Chrome S-shaped tonearm with round soundbox (aluminium diaphragm, bakelite base, chrome slotted cap, knurled needle screw), parks far right
Removable winding crank in right side wall (30–35 turns), carbolite grip, stows clipped inside lid
Speed regulator lever + dial «МЕДЛЕН/78/БЫСТРО» (78±8 rpm) left of platter; brake lever right; autostop toggle
Needle box (ящичек для сменных игл) sunk into a deck corner (nickel-brass on Moscow variant)
Internal exponential tinplate horn under deck; sound exits via ornately shaped (oval) window in the rear deck panel — played lid-open
Lid interior: cloth lining with factory rhombus decal; wire record holder (some variants)
Performance for flavour: 78 rpm, ~80–100 dB, one wind ≈ one-two 25-cm record sides (~3 min/side)
